_README.usage: Models listed here are exposed through OpenRouter. Aliases are case-insensitive.

field_descriptions.model_name: The model identifier - OpenRouter format (e.g., 'anthropic/claude-opus-4') or custom model name (e.g., 'llama3.2')
field_descriptions.aliases: Array of short names users can type instead of the full model name
field_descriptions.context_window: Total number of tokens the model can process (input + output combined)
field_descriptions.max_output_tokens: Maximum number of tokens the model can generate in a single response
field_descriptions.supports_extended_thinking: Whether the model supports extended reasoning tokens (set from the provider's advertised reasoning support)
field_descriptions.supports_json_mode: Whether the model can guarantee valid JSON output
field_descriptions.supports_function_calling: Whether the model supports function/tool calling
field_descriptions.supports_images: Whether the model can process images/visual input
field_descriptions.max_image_size_mb: Maximum total size in MB for all images combined (capped at 40MB max for custom models)
field_descriptions.supports_temperature: Whether the model accepts temperature parameter in API calls (set to false for O3/O4 reasoning models)
field_descriptions.temperature_constraint: Type of temperature constraint: 'fixed' (fixed value), 'range' (continuous range), 'discrete' (specific values), or omit for default range
field_descriptions.use_openai_response_api: Set to true when the model must use the /responses endpoint (reasoning models like GPT-5.2 Pro). Leave false/omit for standard chat completions.
field_descriptions.default_reasoning_effort: Default reasoning effort level for models that support it (e.g., 'low', 'medium', 'high'). Omit if not applicable.
field_descriptions.intelligence_score: 1-20 human rating used as the primary signal for auto-mode model ordering. Since 2026-10-28 it is anchored to the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5 at HIGH reasoning effort (aa_index_by_effort['high'], leaderboard read 2026-10-28) through the v5 ladder in docs/model_ranking.md, which keeps the 1-20 scale of the earlier v4.3 ladder. Entries without aa_index_by_effort carry estimated scores; models that AA measured on v4.3 but not on v5 keep their v4.3-based scores. PAL tools default to thinking_mode medium, so a typical call can score a few Index points below the anchor.
field_descriptions.aa_index: Optional AA Index value behind intelligence_score at the high-effort anchor (interpolated or estimated where AA has no high row; the description says which). Used to order models that share the same intelligence_score.
field_descriptions.aa_index_by_effort: Optional per-effort Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index values (v5 leaderboard, read 2026-10-28), keyed by effort (non-reasoning, low, medium, high, xhigh, max; 'default' for a model with a single row). Values AA marks as incomplete (*) are left out.
field_descriptions.effort_levels: Optional list of reasoning-effort levels this route accepts. When set, PAL sends the tool's thinking_mode as an explicit effort, clamped to these levels; when absent, no effort is sent.
field_descriptions.allow_code_generation: Whether this model can generate and suggest fully working code - complete with functions, files, and detailed implementation instructions - for your AI tool to use right away. Only set this to 'true' for a model more capable than the AI model / CLI you're currently using.

OpenRouter Fusion Router - a meta-router (LLM council behind one slug): a panel of up to 8 models answers in parallel, an analyst compares them, and a synthesis model writes the final answer. Costs ~4-5x a single completion at the default 3-model panel (dynamic pricing). NEVER auto-selected (auto_selectable false); use only when explicitly named. Provisional score 14 (meta-router, not Artificial-Analysis-calibrated).

OpenRouter Fusion Router - Quality preset SKU. A meta-router whose panel is pinned to a frontier trio (Claude Opus + GPT + Gemini Pro); an analyst compares them and a synthesis model writes the answer. Highest quality, highest cost (~4-5x a single completion, dynamic pricing). NEVER auto-selected (auto_selectable false); use only when explicitly named. Provisional score 14 (meta-router, not Artificial-Analysis-calibrated).

OpenRouter Fusion Router - Fast preset SKU. The same meta-router pipeline on the vendor 'general-fast' panel, tuned for low-latency agentic turns and lower cost than the Quality SKU (still several times a single completion). NEVER auto-selected (auto_selectable false); use only when explicitly named. Provisional score 13 (meta-router, not Artificial-Analysis-calibrated).

Inception Mercury 3 via OpenRouter (announced 2026-10-19) - a diffusion LLM: it refines many tokens in parallel instead of writing one token at a time, at about 1,000 tokens/s (Inception reports 1,068 on NVIDIA GPUs). 1M context, text only. $0.10/$0.35 per M at launch ($0.20/$0.70 list). PROVISIONAL score: AA has not measured it yet (Mercury 2.5 scores AA 12). Inception's launch post reports its own scores at medium effort: Mercury 3 beats GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 on 8 of 12 benchmarks (for example SWE-Bench Atlas 51.1 vs 33.3 and 32.3) and trails Haiku on DeepSWE (46.3 vs 51.6). No third party has checked them, so the estimate sits just below GPT-6 Luna (13) until AA measures it. On 2026-10-27 AA still listed only Mercury 2.5 and Mercury 2. Vals AI measured Mercury 3 at high effort: Vals Index 43.66% (rank 25 of 28). Reasoning effort: instant, low, medium or high (default low); Inception documents no xhigh or max level. Live-tested through PAL's OpenRouter provider on 2026-10-20: it answered correctly.
